speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of AIDS and prior fungal infections, I need to rule out opportunistic eye infections. Are you currently on antiretroviral therapy, and do you know your most recent CD4 count?

text: My main symptom is Decreased vision and black spots in the right eye. I also have No pain, Left eye is asymptomatic.

text: I see you are currently not on antiretroviral therapy, which significantly increases your risk for opportunistic infections like CMV retinitis. I need to visualize the back of your eye to confirm this, so I will now examine your retina. REQUEST IMAGES
